body.statement: When \(K=2\), under known sequential randomization and sequential positivity in the finite SMART FFRCISTG model, the sharp identified set for the oracle success probability \(Q\{\max_{d\in\mathcal D}Y(d)=1\}\) is the interval \([V^-(P),V^+(P)]\).

source.verbatim_statement: Under consistency, sequential exchangeability, positivity, and a FFRCISTG model, V^{\mathrm{perfect}}\in[V^-,V^+]. The interval is sharp in that both endpoints can be attained by a joint counterfactual distribution consistent with the observed data generating process.

attestation.note: Verified directly from the arXiv:2608.03133v1 source tarball, main.tex lines 158-164; Appendix proof is present in the same complete source archive. The finite known-randomization SMART statement is a restriction of the theorem setting.
